definitions.error: (sensor - meter) / meter x 100, in %; negative = the sensor read low
definitions.ci: trial values: 95 % CI = 2.5th to 97.5th percentile of 2,000 bootstrap resamples of participants (seed 600); report values have no CI (they are all the reports found, not a sample)
definitions.trial_all: verified fingerstick pairs, study window, all 226 participants, run-in and randomised phase (accuracy_v2.py Set B = preprocess.verified_pairs())
definitions.trial_arm: the same pairs, CGM+BGM arm, randomised phase only (accuracy_v2.py Set A)
definitions.trial_randomised: the same pairs, all participants, randomised phase only (the 26 trial weeks)
definitions.report_pair: a report whose text states both the sensor value and the meter value; first pair of the report
definitions.per_1000_checks: share of pairs x 10: such errors per 1,000 fingerstick checks
definitions.participants_with_at_least_one: participants with one or more such pairs in the set; the time base is follow_up_days_median of the set
definitions.trial_percentile: share of trial pairs with an error at or below the value (reads low), or 100 minus the share at or above it (reads high)
definitions.reads_low_and_reads_high: reads low = error below 0; reads high = error above 0; pairs with equal values are in neither
definitions.central_95_range: 2.5th to 97.5th percentile of the signed error of the trial set
definitions.thresholds: fixed error sizes in %: -66 = median of malfunction-only pairs; -69 and +164 = false-low and hidden-low sizes of the three-fault simulation; -77 = Abbott reads-low median; +44 = Dexcom median

trial_all.label: All verified fingerstick pairs (run-in and randomised phase)

trial_randomised.label: Check: all participants, randomised phase only (26 trial weeks)

abbott_serious.label: FDA reports: Abbott, death or injury
abbott_serious.source: fda-maude/clean/text_extract_v3.jsonl through brand_comparison.build_frame() and pairs_from(): serious tier, wrong-reading set, plausible values

dexcom_serious.label: FDA reports: Dexcom, death or injury
dexcom_serious.source: fda-maude/clean/text_extract_v3.jsonl through brand_comparison.build_frame() and pairs_from(): serious tier, wrong-reading set, plausible values

malfunction.label: FDA reports: malfunction only (no harm coded)
malfunction.source: fda-maude/clean/regex_v2_full.csv.gz: event group malfunction, both values stated (the rule of report_regex_v2.load_full())

fault_shares.label: False low: sensor under 70 while the meter is 70 or above
False low, strict: sensor under 70 while the meter is 70 to 250
Hidden low: sensor 70 or above while the meter is under 70
Hidden low, strict: sensor 70 or above while the meter is under 54
Floor reading: sensor 40 or below while the meter is over 250
